requirements.statement: B0-6 / B4s, owner decisions 132/377: a reservation stranded by a service restart releases and settles exactly once, frees capacity, and writes no terminal or terminal-outbox row; the original B0-2 terminal test stays skipped.
O0c: every lifetime-cap registry entry, including a stale site, must name a nonempty ends description and an existing test; new or increased count-limit sites must be registered.
O0c / B0-6 P3: failed-before-launch lease lifecycles beyond the lease verification limit must leave live capacity counts readable after their real, exactly-once releases.

RS-8 / B0-6: lease, reservation, open-binding and result-custody settlement rows recover across pre-settlement stops, cuts before and after release, and lost post-commit replies, with stable replay and baseline live capacity.

RS-8 / B0-6: driver-entry and preparation memory rows retain custody for a live instance, recover across lost registration replies and cuts before and after recovery release, preserve replay after clock rollback, and permit unattended orchestration close.
RS-8: independently disabling each covered settlement or memory recovery release must make that same row fail its ordinary release oracle.
